text.text_excerpt: Stopped in on the recommendation of a local and holy hell are we glad we listened! Don't let the wait deter you - this place is 100% worth it! Friendly waitress, quick food prep, and fun atmosphere make French Toast all the better. 3 of our party of 6 ordered the chicken and waffles and it was amazing. Enough food to have been shared by the 3 of them but we all ordered separately and ate every bite. Perfectly fried chicken, soft fluffy waffles, and topped with sriracha butter & sweet syrup - perfect sweet and spicy combo. Coconut cream stuff french toast was awesome. Huge slice of soft bread was stuffed bull of sweet cream and topped with grilled pineapple and candied macadamia nuts. YUM....

French Toast is a great brunch spot in the French Quarter. It is like a diner but not your standard diner food. Fantastic list of breakfast bubblies. Really friendly service. And good food. It's small, so get your name on the waitlist through Yelp. I recommend sitting at the bar, if you can. You can see the food come out, you get seated more quickly, and they have hooks for your bags! The best items we had were chicken and waffles and the pancake balls. The seasoning on the chicken won--hands down. The pancake balls come with different sauces. The caramel was too sweet for us, but I liked the jam and Nutella while my hubby liked the chocolate best. The lemon curd was good too, but just no...

I really enjoyed my first visit here. I was dining alone so it wasn't hard grabbing a seat at the bar. I mulled over if I was feeling more savory or sweet. I talked to the bartender and she suggested I pick and savory option and get a kid size French Toast to go with my selection. That was the perfect suggestion! I ended up going with the bacon, onion, and cheese creole and I added scrambled eggs. My order came out super quick considering how busy they were. I decided to go for my French Toast first so it wouldn't get to cold before I had a chance to dig in. The Toast slices were super think and the perfect texture. The flavor of the Toast was pretty good but you could still taste the egg...
